limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. Standard cyclic-subgroup structure, Hasse-diagram ideas, the product-of-paths description of Gamma(C_n), the general diameter bounds of Cameron--Reddy--Sharma, and existing cyclic-subgroup-graph literature are prior art. The abstract rank/meet argument may be implicit in general poset folklore. The long-cycle classification is exact inside C_n and gives sufficient conditions in an ambient group, but does not classify all ambient sources of such cycles. No independent validation is asserted.
provenance: An exact intersection formula for distances in cyclic subgroup graphs, with induced geodesics and sharp corrections to the induced-path and induced-cycle assertions in Proposition 2.5 of arXiv:2409.13796v2.
record_title: Exact intersection metric and sharp induced-subgraph corrections for cyclic subgroup graphs
